title: Summary: the parameters of a sine signal

clips.caption: Three things to keep from this section: <emphasis level="strong">amplitude</emphasis> sets the height, <emphasis level="strong">frequency</emphasis> sets the density, <emphasis level="strong">phase</emphasis> sets where it starts.

The <emphasis level="strong">period</emphasis> is the reciprocal of the <emphasis level="strong">frequency</emphasis>, and the <emphasis level="strong">angular frequency</emphasis> is 2π times the frequency; they describe the same rate of change.
The next section adds, scales, shifts and reverses these <emphasis level="strong">signals</emphasis>, and watches the combined waveform.
